description: We are six students from The American College of Greece (Deree) in Athens, tackling Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts. Our skills span IT, software and hardware solutions, cybersecurity, data management and design. We aim to build a secure, easy-to-use system that combines astronauts’ physical health data and alerts crews before small issues become serious. Our team is full, but we’d love to connect with mentors in space medicine and health data.
